verses.he: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַל־שׁוּשַׁ֣ן עֵד֑וּת מִכְתָּ֖ם לְדָוִ֣ד לְלַמֵּֽד׃
verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ عَلَى «ٱلسُّوسَنِّ». شَهَادَةٌ مُذَهَّبَةٌ لِدَاوُدَ لِلتَّعْلِيمِ. عِنْدَ مُحَارَبَتِهِ أَرَامَ ٱلنَّهْرَيْنِ وَأَرَامَ صُوبَةَ، فَرَجَعَ يُوآبُ وَضَرَبَ مِنْ أَدُومَ فِي وَادِي ٱلْمِلْحِ ٱثْنَيْ عَشَرَ أَلْفًا.
verses.en: For the Leader; upon Shushan Eduth; Michtam of David, to teach;
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Shushan-eduth, Michtam of David, to teach; when he strove with Aram-naharaim and with Aram-zobah, when Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the valley of salt twelve thousand.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A teaching poem by David, when he fought with Aram Naharaim and with Aram Zobah, and Joab returned, and killed twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt.

verses.he: בְּהַצֹּותֹ֨ו ׀ אֶ֥ת אֲרַ֣ם נַהֲרַיִם֮ וְאֶת־אֲרַ֪ם צֹ֫ובָ֥ה וַיָּ֤שָׁב יֹואָ֗ב וַיַּ֣ךְ אֶת־אֱדֹ֣ום בְּגֵיא־מֶ֑לַח שְׁנֵ֖ים עָשָׂ֣ר אָֽלֶף׃
verses.en: when he strove with Aram-naharaim and with Aram-zobah, and Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the Valley of Salt twelve thousand.

verses.he: אֱ֭לֹהִים זְנַחְתָּ֣נוּ פְרַצְתָּ֑נוּ אָ֝נַ֗פְתָּ תְּשֹׁ֣ובֵ֥ב לָֽנוּ׃
verses.ar: يَا ٱللهُ رَفَضْتَنَا. ٱقْتَحَمْتَنَا. سَخِطْتَ. أَرْجِعْنَا.
verses.en: O God, Thou hast cast us off, Thou hast broken us down; Thou hast been angry; O restore us.
verses.kjv: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.
verses.web: God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.

verses.he: הִרְעַ֣שְׁתָּה אֶ֣רֶץ פְּצַמְתָּ֑הּ רְפָ֖ה שְׁבָרֶ֣יהָ כִי־מָֽטָה׃
verses.ar: زَلْزَلْتَ ٱلْأَرْضَ، فَصَمْتَهَا. ٱجْبُرْ كَسْرَهَا لِأَنَّهَا مُتَزَعْزِعَةٌ!
verses.en: Thou hast made the land to shake, Thou hast cleft it; heal the breaches thereof; for it tottereth.
verses.kjv: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
verses.web: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.

verses.he: הִרְאִ֣יתָה עַמְּךָ֣ קָשָׁ֑ה הִ֝שְׁקִיתָ֗נוּ יַ֣יִן תַּרְעֵלָֽה׃
verses.ar: أَرَيْتَ شَعْبَكَ عُسْرًا. سَقَيْتَنَا خَمْرَ ٱلتَّرَنُّحِ.
verses.en: Thou hast made Thy people to see hard things; Thou hast made us to drink the wine of staggering.
verses.kjv: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
verses.web: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.

verses.he: נָ֘תַ֤תָּה לִּירֵאֶ֣יךָ נֵּ֭ס לְהִתְנֹוסֵ֑ס מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י קֹ֣שֶׁט סֶֽלָה׃
verses.ar: أَعْطَيْتَ خَائِفِيكَ رَايَةً تُرْفَعُ لِأَجْلِ ٱلْحَقِّ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear Thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah
verses.kjv: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
verses.web: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

verses.ar: لِكَيْ يَنْجُوَ أَحِبَّاؤُكَ. خَلِّصْ بِيَمِينِكَ وَٱسْتَجِبْ لِي!
verses.en: That Thy beloved may be delivered, save with Thy right hand, and answer me.
verses.kjv: That thy beloved may be delivered; save [with] thy right hand, and hear me.
verses.web: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

verses.he: אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ דִּבֶּ֥ר בְּקָדְשֹׁ֗ו אֶ֫עְלֹ֥זָה אֲחַלְּקָ֥ה שְׁכֶ֑ם וְעֵ֖מֶק סֻכֹּ֣ות אֲמַדֵּֽד׃
verses.ar: ٱللهُ قَدْ تَكَلَّمَ بِقُدْسِهِ: «أَبْتَهِجُ، أَقْسِمُ شَكِيمَ، وَأَقِيسُ وَادِيَ سُكُّوتَ.
verses.en: God spoke in His holiness, that I would exult; that I would divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.kjv: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.web: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

verses.he: לִ֤י גִלְעָ֨ד ׀ וְלִ֬י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה וְ֭אֶפְרַיִם מָעֹ֣וז רֹאשִׁ֑י יְ֝הוּדָ֗ה מְחֹֽקְקִי׃
verses.ar: لِي جِلْعَادُ وَلِي مَنَسَّى، وَأَفْرَايِمُ خُوذَةُ رَأْسِي، يَهُوذَا صَوْلَجَانِي.
verses.en: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.
verses.kjv: Gilead [is] mine, and Manasseh [is] mine; Ephraim also [is] the strength of mine head; Judah [is] my lawgiver;
verses.web: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.

verses.he: מֹואָ֤ב ׀ סִ֬יר רַחְצִ֗י עַל־אֱ֭דֹום אַשְׁלִ֣יךְ נַעֲלִ֑י עָ֝לַ֗י פְּלֶ֣שֶׁת הִתְרֹעָֽעִֽי׃
verses.ar: مُوآبُ مِرْحَضَتِي. عَلَى أَدُومَ أَطْرَحُ نَعْلِي. يَا فَلَسْطِينُ ٱهْتِفِي عَلَيَّ».
verses.en: Moab is my washpot; upon Edom do I cast my shoe; Philistia, cry aloud because of me!
verses.kjv: Moab [is] my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.
verses.web: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”

verses.he: מִ֣י יֹ֭בִלֵנִי עִ֣יר מָצֹ֑ור מִ֖י נָחַ֣נִי עַד־אֱדֹֽום׃
verses.ar: مَنْ يَقُودُنِي إِلَى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ ٱلْمُحَصَّنَةِ؟ مَنْ يَهْدِينِي إِلَى أَدُومَ؟
verses.en: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me unto Edom?
verses.kjv: Who will bring me [into] the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.web: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?

verses.he: הֲלֹֽא־אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים זְנַחְתָּ֑נוּ וְֽלֹא־תֵצֵ֥א אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּצִבְאֹותֵֽינוּ׃
verses.ar: أَلَيْسَ أَنْتَ يَا ٱللهُ ٱلَّذِي رَفَضْتَنَا، وَلَا تَخْرُجُ يَا ٱللهُ مَعَ جُيُوشِنَا؟
verses.en: Hast not Thou, O God, cast us off? And Thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.
verses.kjv: [Wilt] not thou, O God, [which] hadst cast us off? and [thou], O God, [which] didst not go out with our armies?
verses.web: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.

verses.he: הָֽבָה־לָּ֣נוּ עֶזְרָ֣ת מִצָּ֑ר וְ֝שָׁ֗וְא תְּשׁוּעַ֥ת אָדָם׃
verses.ar: أَعْطِنَا عَوْنًا فِي ٱلضِّيقِ، فَبَاطِلٌ هُوَ خَلَاصُ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ.
verses.en: Give us help against the adversary; for vain is the help of man.
verses.kjv: Give us help from trouble: for vain [is] the help of man.
verses.web: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.

verses.ar: بِٱللهِ نَصْنَعُ بِبَأْسٍ، وَهُوَ يَدُوسُ أَعْدَاءَنَا.
verses.en: Through God we shall do valiantly; for He it is that will tread down our adversaries.
verses.kjv: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he [it is that] shall tread down our enemies.
verses.web: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
